description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for performing CRUD operations on notes within an Android application's database.

classes.name: NotesDao
classes.description: A public interface providing methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting note records in the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by the last update in descending order.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Retrieves notes matching a search query in either title or content, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its identifier, or null if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the database and returns the assigned id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note record; returns true if the operation was successful.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its id; returns true if a record was deleted.
